column1: # American forms of the Gutenberg transcription's 1930s printing, and Kingston's own in the 1891 Routledge printing (archive.org swissfamilynewtr00wyssiala). Left out: hyena, wagon, befell, as old forms no longer in use (John's rule, 2026-11-04).
# Added after the six full reads, 2026-11-04. The -ise forms are for one spelling throughout; the 1891 printing itself mixes them.
# The 1891 printing has no toward or afterward at all.
